name: Lily Adventuresses! Episode 4: The Ancienaut beneath the Mask
storyline:
Alorica is an extraterrestrial who was being pursued by a group of seven other extraterrestrials for reasons unknown.
After a long chase, they all crash-landed onto several spots in the Principality of Archytus and then slept for hundreds of years.
As Alorica awakens to a brand-new world in a brand-new timeline, she must know who she really is beneath the proverbial mask, as she saves and befriends Yuria Montes Schnittka, a bounty huntress.
summary: The fourth entry in an RPG anthology series featuring women loving women.
